newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Thousands march for Islamic group Hamas in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Thousands march for Islamic group Hamas in Hebron.

text.p: Thousands of Palestinian Hamas supporters marched in the West Bank town of Hebron on Saturday in a show of strength by the Islamic group, witnesses said.
Hundreds of Palestinian police escorted the marchers along a route in the PLO-ruled area of the divided town far from its Jewish enclaves.
"Jews, Jews, the army of Mohammad will return," marchers chanted, waving the Islamic movement's green flag.
Participants crammed into a courtyard in Hebron after marching for an hour to hear speeches and sing Islamic songs. Women remained separated from the men.
Hamas has spearheaded Palestinian opposition to Israel-PLO peace deals, sending suicide militants on bombing missions inside the Jewish state.

Hebron, home to 100,000 Arabs and 400 Jewish settlers, has been rocked by clashes between Palestinians and Israeli troops since an Israeli woman pasted posters on Palestinian storefronts in the town last month depicting the Moslem prophet Mohammad as a pig.
Israeli leaders condemned the action by the 26-year-old Jerusalem woman, who is standing trial for committing a racist act and other charges.
"Anyone who slanders our great prophet will be burned by our human bombs," one sign at the rally said.
